descriptions.notStarted: Now that I have the Chinese Firecrackers with mysterious powers laden in it, the next stop for me is to go find a town where the ghosts are, and eliminate them with the firecrackers.
descriptions.inProgress: These Chinese Firecrackers with mysterious powers have to be set off near the ghosts. These ghosts are not necessarily easy to find, so I better keep my eyes open. \n\n#o9500197#  #r#a85701##k
